rationale: The V2 full known-answer passed marker readiness and 64 empty-window zero trials, then failed its unchanged known-array scale criterion without preserving the three counter records. A diagnostic-only, versioned harness is required to distinguish payload-bound, event-count, monotonicity, and overhead-spread failure modes before any source repair.

design.counter: same D3-v3 native GC.Alloc Int64 allocation-size counter
